Long-lived machines a project's sessions attach to: create, start, stop, grant and destroy.

:::caution
Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.
:::

## List environments

`GET /v1/environments` (SDK method `listEnvironments`)

The environments of the projects the caller may view, by name; destroyed ones are left out. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectId` | string | no |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [EnvironmentList](/api/reference/types/#environmentlist) (`application/json`). The environments.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create an environment

`POST /v1/environments` (SDK method `createEnvironment`)

Creates an environment and its machine; needs operator on the project. It belongs to the caller unless `projectWide`, and idles until a session uses it. The name is unique in the project (`conflict` otherwise). Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Body**: [CreateEnvironmentBody](/api/reference/types/#createenvironmentbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get an environment

`GET /v1/environments/{environmentId}` (SDK method `getEnvironment`)

The environment, the sessions holding it, its grants and its recent history. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [EnvironmentDetail](/api/reference/types/#environmentdetail) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change an environment

`PATCH /v1/environments/{environmentId}` (SDK method `updateEnvironment`)

Changes its description, idle timeout or size; a new size applies at the next start. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes |  |

**Body**: [UpdateEnvironmentBody](/api/reference/types/#updateenvironmentbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Destroy an environment

`DELETE /v1/environments/{environmentId}` (SDK method `destroyEnvironment`)

Removes its machine and disk, and revokes its grants; needs admin on the project. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment, destroyed.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Start an environment

`POST /v1/environments/{environmentId}/start` (SDK method `startEnvironment`)

Starts a stopped environment; answers as soon as the start is under way. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment, starting.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `422` refused, `429` exhausted, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Stop an environment

`POST /v1/environments/{environmentId}/stop` (SDK method `stopEnvironment`)

Stops it, keeping its disk; the sessions holding it let go. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Environment](/api/reference/types/#environment) (`application/json`). The environment, stopping.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Grant a session an environment

`POST /v1/environments/{environmentId}/grants` (SDK method `grantEnvironment`)

Lets a session in the environment's project use it as `bash`'s `env`, by its alias; needs operator on the project. A session already granted it is answered with its grant. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes |  |

**Body**: [GrantEnvironmentBody](/api/reference/types/#grantenvironmentbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [EnvironmentGrant](/api/reference/types/#environmentgrant) (`application/json`). The grant.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Revoke a session's grant

`DELETE /v1/environments/{environmentId}/grants/{grantId}` (SDK method `revokeEnvironmentGrant`)

Ends the session's use of the environment, and its lease. Experimental: served only where the deployment sets `KANTEL_ENVIRONMENTS=experimental`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `environmentId` | string | yes |  |
| `grantId` | string | yes |  |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Revoked.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
